Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.31.0 turns Myriad Tribulation into a 12 second Thunder God window: lightning-typed bonus damage and Thunderous Judgment are doubled once (physical hits, the fixed 5 point retaliation, and the ultimate's own main strike and aftershocks are explicitly excluded), Thunderous Judgment is refreshed exactly once on cast, the caster gains overcharged avatar arcs with lightning footprints, the main bolt gains a wider core, more branches and visual-only shockwave rings, and the backdrop storm now runs in five density phases across the whole buff. v0.30.0 ribbon lightning, all vehicles, plants and the portable fortress are unchanged. Android rendering, frame time and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
